attr.title: Eldritch
attr.desc: A first-person action game inspired by roguelikes, immersive sims and the works of H. P. Lovecraft. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, sneak or fight past horrors, and recover the souls needed to escape.
attr.inst: Copy all .cpk files from a purchased copy of Eldritch (Windows, Linux or macOS) into ports/eldritch/.
attr.inst_md: Copy all `.cpk` files from a purchased copy of Eldritch (Windows, Linux or macOS) into `ports/eldritch/`.
